units.translation: This second system, corresponding to the following ones, was first correctly written by Weil. In the anapaests one usually distributes dimeters and monometers so as to follow the divisions of sense as closely as possible; accordingly, in c (968 ff.) and d (989 ff.) a monometer is placed in second position, and then likewise in penultimate position, since the total number of metra is even (14). The same number also occurs in b, and after the third strong sense-division; therefore monometer ⟦1⟧, cf. 969 ⟦2⟧. The rest also fits in smoothly and pleasingly. Athena, similarly as before, duly emphasizes the significance of this blessing in relation to the representation of the citizens, the Areopagus. On ⟦3⟧ cf. 919, and ⟦4⟧ 706. The combination of two resolutions in ⟦5⟧ is objectionable; but one can write ⟦6⟧, since the singular is so often used by the chorus.
what things she brings to fulfillment
of things being brought to fulfillment
⟦1⟧: the wish of these deities includes its fulfillment.

⟦1⟧ as the opposite of ⟦2⟧ is no more objectionable than 349 ⟦3⟧ used exclusively of the Olympians. Under the earth are the spirits of the departed; true immortality belongs only to the gods of heaven who dwell in eternal light.
